item.title: Self-Hosted Unique ID Generation Libraries: Snowflake vs ULID vs KSUID vs XID
item.description: Every distributed system needs to generate unique identifiers. Whether it’s database primary keys, event IDs in a message queue, request tracing spans, or object keys in blob storage — the choice of ID generation strategy has far-reaching consequences for database performance, sortability, and debugging experience.
